title: libpod/events: use filepath.Dir for filesystem path
body:
## Description

Small fix for one of the `path` vs `path/filepath` cases from #25165.

In `libpod/events/logfile.go`, the `truncate()` function uses `path.Dir` on a filesystem path (`filePath`). The `path` package uses forward slashes only, so this would misbehave on Windows. Swapping it to `filepath.Dir` fixes that, and since it was the only `path.X` call in the file, I also dropped the `"path"` import.

Same file already uses `filepath.Dir` a few lines up (line 32), so this makes the file internally consistent.

I only tackled this one file rather than doing the whole codebase in one PR — happy to do follow-ups after this lands if that's the preferred pace.

## Testing

`go build ./libpod/events/` passes. No tests in the package to run. Couldn't run `make validatepr` locally (on macOS), so relying on CI to catch anything.

NONE
